stagingRules: Validate staged archive bytes, manifest, file hashes, signature, compatibility and release floor.
Atomically replace active pointer only after validation.
Advance durable release floor after pointer commit.
antiRollback: Candidate releaseSequence must be strictly greater than the durable per-game release floor. Exact replay is allowed only when bytes equal the currently active package after revalidation under the current trust store and APK compatibility policy.
failureRule: Any failure before active-pointer commit leaves the previous active package unchanged.
recoveryRule: If the active pointer is unavailable, reconstruct only the package whose releaseSequence equals the durable committed release floor. Never promote a newer staged but uncommitted inactive-slot package.
